steps.title: Start in the lobby
steps.text: Sign in to the Epic account where you want the Outfit. Select Passes in the top navigation; the first screenshot outlines this entry in red.
steps.hint: Capture the lobby with the Passes entry visible. Highlight that entry in your own screenshot.

steps.title: Browse the available passes
steps.text: If the Passes area opens on Battle Pass, use the Passes & FN Crew entry near the bottom of that screen to browse other passes. The Battle Pass is separate from the Teto Music Mini-Pass.
steps.hint: Capture the Battle Pass overview with the Passes & FN Crew entry visible.

steps.title: Review the Music Pass offer
steps.text: Select TWINDRILL DIVA, then choose Get Music Pass at the bottom right. Review the 1,000 V-Bucks offer and your account balance on the following confirmation screen. Join Fortnite Crew is a separate subscription option; existing active members can use their included access.
steps.hint: Capture the Teto Music Pass with Get Music Pass visible, or its following access confirmation.

steps.title: Claim and equip Teto
steps.text: Pass access immediately unlocks the base Kasane Teto Outfit. The reward screen can show Claimed and offer an Equip button; you can also select the owned Outfit in your Locker. This does not complete the remaining reward progression.
steps.hint: Capture the Teto reward marked Claimed with Equip available, or the owned Outfit in the Locker.

steps.title: Earn and select the reactive style
steps.text: Continue earning XP toward the final pass reward, claim the reactive style, then select the owned Outfit’s style options in your Locker. The screenshot shows Reactive On selected on the final reward page and the captured account’s remaining page-unlock condition.
steps.hint: Capture the final reactive-style reward or its earned style option. Label whether your screenshot shows a preview or an owned reward.

milestones: Epic published the Teto Music Mini-Pass announcement on November 11, 2026, detailing the pass price, instant Outfit unlock and headline rewards.
The Music Mini-Pass launched on November 12, 2026. Epic’s French press release described it as available that day.
Epic scheduled Teto and Cap’n Hatsune Miku’s appearance at Friendship Villa for November 15, separately from the pass launch. The announcement gives a calendar date without an exact arrival hour.
The owner-supplied English Music Pass screen displays Available through JAN 20 2027. This is the date shown in that capture; an exact end hour and timezone are not specified.
profileViews: Teto began as an April Fools’ character in 2008. Her red drill-shaped twin tails and bread motif are recognisable across her reference designs and game adaptation.
UTAU and Synthesizer V are singing-voice products associated with Teto; VOICEPEAK is a separate speaking-voice product. Songwriters and producers use her voice to create their own music.
Official Fortnite promotional art shows the game adaptation. The Music Mini-Pass grants the base Outfit immediately and offers a reactive style as its final reward.
